name: Template E: Standing Appellate Committee (SAC) & Council Appeal Pathway
aphSourceReference: Approval Process Handbook 2024–2027 Chapter II, Clause 2.24(a), (b), (c)
description: Statutory appellate workflow available to institutions aggrieved by an Executive Committee rejection order. Strict statutory mandate: appeal must be lodged within 7 calendar days of portal decision upload.
statutoryConstraints: Strict limitation: Appeal submitted after 7 calendar days (23:59:59 UTC) from rejection upload is time-barred and auto-locked
Standing Appellate Committee reviews appeal and makes recommendations to Council
Council considers SAC recommendations and issues final determinative speaking order
Council decision on appeal is final; no further administrative remedy exists within AICTE
